_note: Tower climb hud animation. Times in seconds; rates in radians per second; distances in 1920x1080 pixels.

flip._note: the floor number's flip takes flip_s; a folding flap darkens to shade_min, its brightness shade_min + shade_range * its height

sway._note: each plank sways on its own, plank i at a phase of i * phase_step; its tilt is the sum of the tilt waves, its x offset of the x waves, its y offset the y wave. A wave is size (degrees for the tilt, px otherwise) * sin(rate * time + phase_scale * the plank's phase).
